title: Apartment
body:
Syntax: apartment name <text>  |  apartment desc <text>

Description: Renames or redescribes your owned apartment. You must be standing inside it. Buying/selling an apartment is done via 'buy apartment'/'sell apartment' while standing in an available unit.

&WRoom expansions:&x Stand in the MAIN apartment room and use 'buy room <type> <direction>'. New rooms connect directly to the main apartment only; you cannot extend another expansion or buy hallways. One of each of five types max. Costs 200k ryo for the 1st room, doubling thereafter (200k/400k/800k/1.6M/3.2M). Existing legacy hallways cannot be built again, but can be sold.

&CBedroom&x - Recovers Health/Chakra/Stamina faster, same as a village Hospital.
&CKitchen&x - Lets you 'cook' without holding a Cooking Pot.
&CPond&x - A water biome, so you can 'fish' here.
&CFarming&x - A plains biome, so you can 'farm' here.
&CStorage&x - Whatever you leave here survives a server restart, unlike anywhere else in the game.

&WSelling:&x 'sell room <type>' removes a purchased expansion room and frees its VNUM, refunding 50% of its cost. If it has legacy rooms attached, sell the children first. 'sell apartment' removes ALL owned expansion rooms and exits (including legacy hallways), frees their VNUMs, refunds 50% of each purchase, and restores the permanent main room to a vacant 'Empty apartment' for the next buyer. 'redit flags apartment' toggles the apartment flag on vacant builder rooms.

Date: 2026-08-17
